description: Turning the user's words into better search queries: expanding abbreviations, adding domain vocabulary, making follow-up questions standalone.
Searching with several model-generated rewrites plus the original question and pooling or fusing the results to raise recall.
Hypothetical Document Embeddings: search with a model-written plausible answer, whose embedding sits closer to real answer passages than the question does. Never shown as evidence.
Splitting a compound question into sub-questions that are retrieved separately.
A second-stage model that scores query and candidate together; accurate but slow, so it runs on the top 20 to 100 candidates of a fast retriever.
A transformer that reads query and passage in one input and outputs a relevance score. The classic reranker; bi-encoders (embeddings) encode them separately.
An optional step that fails returns the result you had without it (retrieval order, the original query) instead of an error.
